en: The ancient Egyptians used an inclined plane ramp 1.5 kilometers long to move the 2.3 million stone blocks of the Great Pyramid.
A single movable pulley reduces the effort force needed to lift a heavy object by exactly half, or 50 percent.
Ice has a very low coefficient of friction, allowing a hockey puck to slide over 50 meters on a smooth rink before stopping.
The Moon's gravity is one sixth of Earth's gravity, meaning a 60 kilogram person would weigh only 10 kilograms there.
The strongest permanent magnets, called neodymium magnets, can lift objects up to 1,000 times their own physical weight.
A single lightning bolt can reach temperatures of 30,000 degrees Celsius, which is five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second, allowing it to circle the Earth's equator about 7.5 times in just one single second.
Sound travels through water at about 1,500 meters per second, which is more than four times faster than it travels through air.
Copper conducts heat about 20 times faster than stainless steel, which is why many cooking pots have copper bottoms for even heating.
A fully charged standard AA alkaline battery stores about 10,000 joules of chemical energy before converting it into electrical energy.
A 5 kilogram bowling ball moving at 5 meters per second has 25 times more kinetic energy than a 0.2 kilogram tennis ball.
A 100 kilogram roller coaster at the top of a 30 meter hill stores exactly 29,400 joules of gravitational potential energy.
